description.value: A community pottery studio and gallery in downtown Nanaimo run by professional artists and potters. Offers drop-in Saturday night pottery wheel sessions requiring no experience, making it accessible to passing visitors. Also features rotating artist-in-residence exhibitions in the gallery space.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 30m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active pottery studio and gallery in downtown Nanaimo offering multi-week classes plus drop-in single-day experiences. The address '115 Chapel St, unit 101' and operating hours are confirmed on the website. No mention anywhere of bike parking, water, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-related amenities. OSM phone number is not visibly repeated in the fetched website text so cannot be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active gallery with drop-in pottery experiences in downtown Nanaimo; a legitimate cultural attraction for touring cyclists looking for a unique activity stop.

wow_evidence: Community pottery studio with drop-in Saturday wheel nights, no experience needed — hands-on fun.
